findings.evidence: “Names contain the visible text; every action is keyboard-operable.” Several rule sections primarily reactivate familiar knowledge: accessibility thresholds here, fetch resolving on HTTP errors at line 71, and outline removal breaking keyboard navigation at line 77. The rule references also repeat elementary CSS and JSX patterns, diluting the stronger framework-specific gotchas and evidence-routing procedures.
findings.fix: Keep standard requirements as terse activation checks, trim repeated explanations and elementary fix-pattern snippets, and concentrate the remaining detail on non-obvious exceptions, framework behavior and adjudication decisions. Preserve required rule definitions and all attribution.

findings.evidence: “The a11y row is fail and its evidence cites form.tsx:19: the #ccc input border is under the 3:1 non-text contrast line”. The supplied form.tsx specifies the border color but no adjacent background color or render, so this assertion requires a contrast verdict from an unprovided color pair, contrary to the source-only uncertainty policy.
findings.fix: Supply explicit adjacent background values or render notes establishing the white background. Otherwise expect na with unverified: needs render instead of requiring a contrast failure.

findings.evidence: “With only code, no fixed container width and no page-level overflow-x is a pass.” Following this branch for a non-wrapping flex row or intrinsically oversized content produces a responsive pass even though the page can overflow. Neither a fixed container width nor an explicit overflow-x declaration is necessary for horizontal overflow; line 99 separately requires uncertainty when width depends on content.
findings.fix: Remove the automatic source-only pass. Fail when source demonstrates an overflow defect, pass only when the available constraints establish reflow and primary-action reachability, and otherwise return na with unverified: needs render. Explicitly include nowrap, intrinsic sizing and flex/grid minimum-size behavior among source checks.
